ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.). This section meets at the IL Center for Rehabilitation and Education, 1950 W. Roosevelt Rd., Chicago, IL 60608.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to EDM: Special Ed - UIUC.
